reason: Morpho Blue isolated lending with oracle-priced collateral, liquidation, borrow-on-behalf authorization and flash loans matches Morpho/Euler/Cauldron/Venus/Wise lending exploits.
Liquity TroveManager (troves, redemptions, liquidations, sorted troves) matches Liquity-fork trove/redemption exploits at Liquity v2 forks, Prisma, Bonq and Raft.
UniswapV2Factory createPair/feeTo surface matches incidents built on permissionless pair creation, V2 pair k-invariant bugs and factory fee access control.
Seaport is an NFT order-fulfillment marketplace with signed orders and EIP-1271 checks, matching NFT marketplace/swap exploits and signature-validation bugs.
Uniswap V3 NonfungiblePositionManager (mint/increase/decrease/collect on concentrated-liquidity NFTs) matches V3 migrator, concentrated-liquidity math, V3 position valuation and LP-manager exploits.
UniswapV2Router02 swap/addLiquidity/removeLiquidity surface matches V2-style DEX router and pair exploits.
GnosisSafe execTransaction/delegatecall/module/owner-signature surface matches Safe-targeted (Bybit, Safe module) and classic multisig wallet exploits.
UniswapV3Factory createPool/fee-tier/owner surface matches V3 fee-tier pool lookup misconfiguration, factory fee access control, pool creation and unauthenticated V3 pool/callback exploits.
Permit2 signature-based transfers, EIP-712 digests, nonces and allowance targets match permit forgery, incomplete signature coverage, replay and allowance-drain exploits.
WETH9 deposit/withdraw/fallback/transferFrom surface matches WETH fallback abuse, wrapped-token burn/mint flaws, native deposit spoofing and allowance-check bugs.
UniversalRouter command-dispatch over V2/V3 swaps and permit2 matches UniversalRouter-driven and route-processing/aggregator router exploits with user-supplied calldata.
Uniswap V3 SwapRouter exactInput/exactOutput with uniswapV3SwapCallback matches router exploits via unauthenticated V3 swap callbacks and attacker-controlled routes.
